intendedFor: экспериментальная проверка Discord desktop, когда DNS edge diagnostics показывают SYN-SENT до TLS
owner-provided community preset, который на той же сети помогал Windows GUI для YouTube и Discord
ручной выбор во вкладке Стратегии; не включается автоматически
notes: WinDivert --wf-* switches are not passed to Linux nfqws2; nftables owner-confirmed apply still decides what reaches NFQUEUE.
Discord Cloudflare edge IPs come from Stage 7h/7i diagnostics and are used only as an experimental ipset-ip pre-TLS profile.
hostfakesplit_multi is provided by core/zapret2/lua/custom_funcs.lua as a conservative compatibility shim over built-in hostfakesplit.
Voice/UDP STUN profile from the Windows preset is intentionally not ported here; Stage 8 remains reserved for voice.
Stage 7m adds the community-observed TCP 5222 port to Discord hostfakesplit profiles; this is a diagnostic port hint, not a claim that it fixes the updater SYN-SENT blocker.

serviceTarget.summary: Windows-inspired strategy seed for Discord pre-TLS edge SYN-SENT diagnostics and ordinary app/gateway/CDN phases; YouTube TCP/QUIC fallback included from the same community preset.
serviceTarget.title: Discord desktop non-voice + YouTube fallback
